name: rdk llm

check.cmd: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && hash vocano_cli > /dev/null 2>&1 && hash gradio > /dev/null 2>&1 && hash openai > /dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d ~/Pictures ] && echo install || echo uninstall

install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && hash gradio > /dev/null 2>&1 || pip install gradio
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && hash openai > /dev/null 2>&1 || pip install openai
pip show rdk_gateway_ai > /dev/null 2>&1 || pip install rdk_gateway_ai -i http://archive.d-robotics.cc/simple/ --trusted-host archive.d-robotics.cc
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && hash vocano_cli > /dev/null 2>&1 || pip install vocano_test -i http://archive.d-robotics.cc/simple/ --trusted-host archive.d-robotics.cc
uninstall: pip uninstall rdk_gateway_ai -y && pip uninstall vocano_test -y

description.zh: RDK大模型：可以借助RDK设备轻松使用大模型。
